segments.title: Chương 18: Lớp này nhất định phải thăng cấp, Chúa Giê-su cũng không ngăn được
segments.content:
Chapter 18: I'm definitely moving up a class, not even Jesus can keep me here

Huh? Renew for sixty sessions?!!! Jiang Nian was speechless. He had to admit, the system was pretty lame too.

But he would renew it anyway. It was money earned, no matter who earned it.

However, today was Tuesday, and the test scores would probably be out today or tomorrow. The homeroom teacher could call him in for a talk about moving up a class at any moment, so it wasn't a good time to ask for leave.

Jiang Nian planned to go to the gym and do the missions after the class promotion results were confirmed.

Managing a million things a day, I'm really worrying myself to death.

What was it like to get first place in the class? Jiang Nian said it didn't feel like much. Everyone in the class knew he was moving up and joked that he was about to ascend.

No one jumped up to question if he had cheated. No one in the class was that stupid. Over the past two days, the subject teachers had called on him to answer questions at least a dozen times, and he got every single one right.

There were some English words that even the students with good English grades had never heard of, but Jiang Nian could spell them out casually. For short sentence grammar, as long as it involved memorization, he could answer instantly.

Except for math and some calculations, Jiang Nian wasn't skilled in those areas.

For some of the memorization-based knowledge points in the comprehensive science exam, even the teachers would forget them from time to time. But Jiang Nian remembered them clearly, answering casually during class interactions without even needing to open his book.

With this level of memory, only an idiot would jump up and question him.

Afternoon.

The September weather was scorching, and the fans on the classroom ceiling creaked and whined.

The first three periods in the afternoon were all comprehensive science subjects, and the lesson content was going over the rest of the test papers from yesterday. The students were utterly drowsy, their heads bobbing up and down.

A breeze picked up outside the classroom, making the curtains dance wildly.

Jiang Nian was also propping his head up with his hand, his thoughts already drifting to the edge of the sky. The three comprehensive science teachers knew he was moving up, so they simply turned a blind eye.

Near the end of the school day, there was a half-hour self-study session.

It was usually a rotation between self-study and listening comprehension practice. As luck would have it, today was Tuesday, and it was the English listening session. The broadcast started playing the test audio, and the sound of flipping books filled the classroom.

"Jiang Nian, let me copy your answers for the listening comprehension later."

"Uh, okay."

He actually didn't want to do the listening comprehension at all, but to maintain his image and stand his last post, he reluctantly opened his listening comprehension book and looked at the questions with an unwilling expression.

The dusk outside the window pierced into the classroom, casting a rosy glow over all the students hunched over their desks looking at the questions. Thanks to the sunset clouds, even the pages of the books looked yellow.

This was what the third year of high school was like. Looking down, you saw a sea of questions; looking up, you saw the homeroom teacher.

"Huh? The homeroom teacher!!"

The homeroom teacher paused in front of his desk and said, "Come to the office. I need to talk to you about something."

Jiang Nian felt a bit calmer, guessing that this was the talk related to moving up a class. He stood up with composure, left his seat, and followed the teacher out of the classroom.

After he left, whispers arose from the seats around him.

"The homeroom teacher is looking for Jiang Nian. Is he moving up a class?"

"Probably. If you score over 570 and don't move up, I'd have ascended to heaven by now."

"How did he study over the summer break? How is he so awesome? Damn, how is his brain wired to remember so much stuff?"

Zhou Yuting felt annoyed listening to them, her knuckles turning white as she gripped her pen. She wanted to yell at them to shut up, but she held it in.

She couldn't show any reaction in front of others, or she would truly lose all face.

What would the homeroom teacher say to Jiang Nian? He would probably talk to her as well. Thinking this, Zhou Yuting couldn't help but drift off, only snapping back to reality when the listening comprehension was more than halfway through.

She swallowed. If it was destined that only one person could move up, it wasn't like she had absolutely no chance.

As long as…

In the office.

The homeroom teacher was talking with Jiang Nian, first confirming his willingness to move up a class.

"Moving up a class doesn't necessarily mean your grades will improve. The change in environment, interpersonal relationships, the pace of learning, the teachers' emphasis in their lectures—all these things can affect your grades."

"Staying in this class doesn't mean your grades can't improve, either. All our subject teachers have master's degrees. They have many years of teaching experience and also for top students… ahem." "We tailor our teaching to the student's aptitude, what's commonly known as… giving special attention."

After all that talk, wasn't it just because you can't bear to let me go?

Blah, blah, blah.

Sorry, I'm definitely moving up from this class. It's no use even if Jesus comes.

The homeroom teacher spoke until his mouth was dry, then picked up his goji berry thermos and took a sip.

"So, what are your thoughts?"

"Mhm." Jiang Nian nodded, then spoke as the homeroom teacher's face lit up with joy, "Can I choose which class I move up to? Or is it randomly assigned?"

The homeroom teacher's smile froze. All joy and sorrow vanished from his life.

You little brat… you really are stubborn!

"Since you've decided, then… ahem." The homeroom teacher cleared his throat. There was nothing he could do if he couldn't keep him. "It's all assigned. Do you have a preference?"

"Can you pull some strings?" Jiang Nian, of course, wanted to go to Xu Qianqian's class.

"Theoretically, it's possible, but in reality…" The homeroom teacher took a sip of water and said no more. "The grade director has more sway. I'm just a person of humble station."

Damn, playing games with me, are you?

During the short break after school in the afternoon, Xu Qianqian returned from the cafeteria and sought out Jiang Nian.

The lights in the school building were on. The two of them were leaning against the corridor railing, chatting.

"I heard from Yunyun that you scored 573?" Xu Qianqian turned her head, her hair tied in a small bun. "Did you ask your homeroom teacher which class you're moving to?"

"I don't know. If I can choose, I'll go to your class." Jiang Nian leaned on the railing, looking lazy. The evening clouds were heavy in front of them. "If I can't choose, then I'll leave it to fate."

"Choose… our class?" Xu Qianqian was startled. "Why?"

Jiang Nian glanced at her and said casually.

"Isn't it good to be a little closer to you?"

Upon hearing this, Xu Qianqian's face instantly turned red. Luckily, the twilight concealed it, so it wasn't obvious. A whisper, like the buzz of a tiny mosquito, passed through the night wind, at a volume only the two of them could hear.

"Don't come. I don't want you here."

"Tch."

During the second evening self-study session, Zhou Yuting was also called out by the homeroom teacher.

Jiang Nian heard the sound and looked up at the door. Zhou Yuting happened to look back. Across more than half the classroom, their gazes met in mid-air.

It was cold and distant, making Zhou Yuting's heart sink.

In the corridor, she couldn't help but recall a rumor spreading in the class. That Jiang Nian had suffered some kind of shock over the summer break and had shut himself in to study for two months, which was how he became who he was now.

Zhou Yuting didn't feel guilty, only annoyed. She needed Jiang Nian to voluntarily give up the promotion.

In the brightly lit office, the homeroom teacher repeated what he had said in the afternoon.

"With your current score, it's actually a real stretch to move up a class. Even if you just scrape by, the atmosphere in the Olympiad class might not be suitable for you."

"Besides, in principle, there's only one spot for promotion in our class right now. Jiang Nian is forty points ahead of you, and he already confirmed this afternoon that he wants to move up."

"So, you should understand…"

"Mhm, what if Jiang Nian voluntarily gives it up?" Zhou Yuting asked.

The homeroom teacher was at a loss for words. "You'll have to ask him about that. I don't recommend either of you move up. A new and unfamiliar group environment takes time to adapt to."

"I understand, teacher." Zhou Yuting stood up. "I will find a way myself. Thank you, teacher."

The homeroom teacher: "???"

(End of this chapter)
